title: Data for normalized completed tensor constraints
statement: Let B and E be symmetric monoidal categories, P and P prime object properties, T and T prime endofunctors with natural units eta and eta prime, and L:B→E. Define left insertion to be T(eta_X tensor 1_Y) and right insertion T(1_X tensor eta_Y). CompletedConstraintModel asserts tensor object T(X tensor Y), tensor map T(f tensor g), unit T(1), associator inverse left insertion followed by T(alpha) and right insertion, braiding T(beta), and both unitors inverse unit insertion followed by T of the original unitor and inverse eta on the local input. completeInverse is the restriction of L followed by T prime to the full local subcategories when T prime lands in P prime. CompletedPullbackCoherence asserts an oplax monoidal structure on that functor with the prescribed completed tensor and unit isomorphisms and symmetry square. CompletedTensorAssertions combines invertibility of the units on local objects and of all tensor/pullback insertions with the ordinary unit laws, completed comparison normalization and uniqueness, exact completed constraint models and completed functor coherence. For constant coefficient sites, use the actual completion reflector of lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction and the published native derived tensor structure of lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal. constantDerivedMonoidal, constantDerivedSymmetric and constantDerivedTensor name that native structure and bifunctor. ConstantTensorData is the canonical scalar-extension pure-tensor comparison. ConstantTensorNormalization is its flat-term K-flat cochain representative square using native tensorIso and the actual derived inverse-image comparison.
